description: Companion classification for /api/v1 routes intentionally excluded from the stable customer integration OpenAPI contract. External routes belong in openapi/corvis-v1.yaml; entries here are product/control-plane endpoints whose compatibility is governed by the Corvis application rather than the external API contract.

routes.reason: Tenant-wide privileged control plane; requires authoritative tenant_admin scope.
Organization access administration surface; tenant-admin-only product workflow, not a stable customer data-integration API.
Authenticated, verified-email, single-use onboarding acceptance; token-derived tenant/workspace membership is created before ordinary authorization.
Workspace source-connector configuration surface; not a stable customer data-integration API.
Review Analyst workflow command surface used by the Corvis product.
Review Analyst/reconciliation workflow surface used by the Corvis product.
Corvis sector taxonomy reference read used by the product UI; versioned with the taxonomy rather than the stable integration contract.
Review Analyst company-to-sector classification workflow (read and governed assign command) used by the Corvis product.
Customer Overview rollup (value trend, exposure, attention, freshness) composed for the Corvis product UI; its shape follows the dashboard, not the stable integration contract.
Workspace portfolio-attribution read surface; kept outside the stable integration contract until portfolio management/import semantics are finalized.
Workspace portfolio-to-holding attribution/read surface; it never grants fund access or ownership-weights underlying operating facts.
Tenant operator recovery command; requires tenant_admin scope.
Tenant operator dead-letter recovery command; requires tenant_admin scope.
Document provenance/lifecycle read composed for the Corvis Documents view; not part of the stable integration contract.
Position financial-statement analytics read composed for the Corvis Analytics view; versioned with the product rather than the stable integration contract.
Per-user workspace personalization (saved views, dashboard layout) for the Corvis product UI.
SCIM 2.0 user provisioning for tenant identity providers; authenticated by a tenant SCIM bearer token and governed by the SCIM protocol, not the Corvis JSON envelope contract.
Browser error-report ingest for the Corvis product UI; accepts only the PII-free client error event and writes it to server logs.
Cloud Run startup/readiness probe (configuration and database reachability), not a customer data contract.
Runtime health endpoint, not a customer data contract.
